chants.vernacular_text: Shout joyfully to God, all the earth, alleluia; sing a psalm to his name, alleluia; praise him with magnificence, alleluia, alleluia, alleluia. ℣. Say to God: "How awesome are your deeds, O Lord! In the greatness of your power, your enemies will be convicted of lying to you".
The disciples recognized the Lord Jesus at the breaking of the bread.
It was necessary that Christ should suffer and rise from the dead, and so enter into his glory.
Praise the Lord, O my soul; I will praise the Lord throughout my life; I will sing to my God for as long as I live, alleluia.
The Lord has risen and has appeared to Peter, alleluia.
Sing unto the Lord, alleluia; sing to the Lord, bless his name; proclaim his salvation day after day, alleluia, alleluia.
"Simon, son of John, do you love me more than these?" – "Lord, you know all things, you know, O Lord, that I love you, alleluia."
